title: Angles
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4; not yet checked by a Kenyan maths teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Outcomes a to c are KICD's words (verified); d is attitudinal. Grade 4 only identifies and relates angles to turns: no measuring in degrees and no named types (acute, obtuse) are in the outcomes. A right angle is met as a quarter turn, as outcome c links turns and angles.

skills.key_step: The child sees an angle as the opening between two lines that meet at a point, whatever their length or the way they face.

floor.prerequisite: Moves along a straight line from a point (Grade 3).
floor.question: Point to where the two edges of a book meet.

representations: two sticks joined at one end
steps: Find the point where two lines meet.
The angle is the opening between them.
Long or short arms do not change it.
Turned any way, it is still an angle.

board.do: Draw two angles with the same opening, one with long arms.
Shade both openings the same size.

misconceptions.ask: Is the opening wider or just the arms longer?
misconceptions.repair: Only the arms: they are the same.

misconceptions.ask: Is the angle a line or the space between two lines?
How many corners does a triangle have?
Turn the page. Is the opening still there?

checks.question: How many angles has a square?
Two angles have the same opening; one has arms twice as long. Which is bigger?

skills.key_step: The child finds angles at the corners of objects, of any opening, and knows curved edges have none.

floor.question: Where is the angle in an open pair of scissors?

steps: Look for corners where two straight edges meet.
Square corners are right angles; others are angles too.

board.do: Draw a book, a triangular flag and a plate.
Mark the angles: book 4, flag 3, plate 0.

misconceptions.ask: Can you find a corner on a circle?
Count the corners of a rectangle.
Does a door have square corners?
misconceptions.repair: Yes: a rectangle has right angles too.

misconceptions.ask: Do two edges meet at the point of the flag?

checks.question: How many angles has a triangle?
Does a rectangle have right angles?

skills.key_step: The child links turns to angles: a quarter turn makes a right angle, a half turn a straight line, a full turn returns to the start; a bigger turn makes a bigger angle.

floor.question: How many quarter turns make a half turn?

representations: two strips joined with a pin
steps: Start with the two strips together.
Turn one a quarter: a right angle.
Turn a half: a straight line.
Turn a full turn: back to the start.

board.say: How much has the minute hand turned from 12 to 3?

board.do: Mark the square corner: a right angle.

misconceptions.ask: Is a quarter turn half way round?
misconceptions.repair: No: it makes a right angle.

misconceptions.ask: Which opens wider, a quarter or a half turn?
Fit a book corner between the hands at 3 o'clock.
Which turn makes a straight line?
misconceptions.repair: A half turn; a full turn goes back to the start.

checks.question: What angle does a quarter turn make?
Which makes a bigger angle, a half turn or a quarter turn?
